description: Patch an existing audio overlay. Only the fields you pass are changed. Pass endFrame:null to clear it (revert to natural-length playback).

denoiseStrength.description: Clean-strength wet/dry mix 0..1 for an overlay with an AI-cleaned track: 1 = fully cleaned, 0 = fully original, between = blend. null clears it (full clean). Ignored while the Original track is selected.

endFrame.description: End frame, or null to clear and use the asset's natural length.

filename.description: Replace the track's audio: the stored filename an upload returned.

name.description: The track's label people see (pass the upload's returned `name` alongside a replacement `filename`), or null to remove it.

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.

sourceLayerId.description: Weld the overlay to a video layer ("video.<id>") so it renders as a clip footer and drags with the clip, or null to detach it back into a standalone track.

name: update_audio_overlay

outputSchema.description: The result envelope every Morpha tool returns.

data.description: The payload, shaped by the tool.

editorUrl.description: Opens this project in the editor.

note.description: What to do next when not ready.

status.description: For cache-backed readers: whether the answer was ready.
